description: This PHP class 'FormatWithWorkStation' implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface to provide a method for formatting entity values, specifically retrieving and returning the name of a subunit based on an ID. It utilizes a trait for accessing company structure services and interacts with the 'Subunit' entity.

classes.name: FormatWithWorkStation
classes.description: A class that formats a value by retrieving the name of a subunit entity based on an ID.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the name of the Subunit entity corresponding to the given ID, or null if not found.
